benign_fpr_definition: fraction of true BENIGN flows predicted ATTACK; identical to random-v2 / temporal / lofo / live

paired_comparison.procedure: each final eval run: one raw capture -> same python cfm extraction -> Model A prediction AND Model B prediction on the identical flows
paired_comparison.forbidden: comparing Model A old-run metrics against Model B new-run metrics as the primary adaptation claim

model_b_success_criteria: a defensible, pre-registered comparison against Model A on identical new flows; Model B is NOT required to win, only to be measured fairly
thresholds: fixed before viewing final results; never tuned on final test
